brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) enclosed with solid top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and 6 solid end caps on all side faces - forms sealed enclosure
Port louvre installed (port:0#0,0#0 hex-port-louvre) on side slot 0 - designed to vent closed cell without letting rain in

finish.summary: Built closed single-cell enclosure from full hex base, topped with solid cover and all 6 side faces capped; one side port replaced with hex-port-louvre to provide breathing ventilation for internal board while remaining weather-resistant.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.
